text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

INDIA, October 29 - Bombay - Delays expected for vessels due, containers 2-3 days, bulk vessels 5-6 days, general cargo 3-4 days. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 22 discharging at berth. 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 14 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 7 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Calcutta - 23 vessels due. 8 Vessels loading at berth, 10 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. Cochin - Delays expected for vessels due, containers, breakbulk, fertiliser, general cargo up to 1 day, crude tankers 1-2 days. 2 Tankers waiting at anchorage, 2 vessels under repair/drydock. Mormugao - One petcoke due with up to 1 days delay expected, 7 ores due with 4-5 days delay expected. 1 Vessel loading at berth, 3 loading at anchorage, 1 discharging at berth. 5 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 under repair/drydock, 1 awaiting orders.

Kandla - Delays expected for vessels due, rice 6-7 days, teus 2-3 days, rock phosphate, alumina products 6-7 days. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 1 loading at anchorage, 3 discharging at berth. 8 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 23 Tankers waiting. Mangalore - Two vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 5 loading/discharging at anchorage, 2 awaiting berth. Madras - Thirty-five vessels due of which 6 coal/coke, 3 edible oil, 11 containers, 10 general cargo, 2 granite block 1 molasses, 1 fertiliser, 1 scrap. Delays expected, coal/coke 3-4 days, fertiliser 2-3 days, scrap 4-5 days, others 2-3 days. 2 Vessels loading at berth, 14 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 12 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 2 Vessels under repair/drydock.

Jawaharlal Nehru - Berthing delays of 15-20 days for fertiliser and raw material. 2 Vessels due (tankers/iron ore), up to 1 days berthing delay expected. 2 Vessels discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load. Paradip - Vessels due, 2 coal, 2 chrome, 1 iron ore, 1 food, 1 chemical. Delays expected coal 2 days, chrome 2 days, iron ore 3 days, fertiliser 10 days, oil 4 days. 4 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. 2 vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. Tuticorin - Six vessels due, 1 days berthing delay. 3 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 awaiting orders. Visakhapnam - Delays expected for vessels due, iron ore up to 1 day, bars, steel cargo, wire coils, debars, granite blocks, chrome, coking coal, clinker, palm oil, carbon anode, steel rails, baked anode 7-8 days, pig iron 4-5 days, molasses 3-4 days, rock phosphate 10-12 days. 5 Vessels loading at berth, 8 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to discharge at inner harbour.

MALAYSIA, October 30 - Port Kelang - Container berths, 4 vessels alongside, 2 berthed. Deep draft conventional wharf, 4 vessels alongside, 3 berthed, 6 waiting. Waiting time of 4 days. Dry bulk terminal, 1 vessel alongside, 5 waiting. Waiting time 12 days. West port, 4 conventional vessels alongside, 2 Cement carrier vessels alongside discharging, 1 ro/ro alongside. Waiting time of 1 day.
MAURITIUS, October 29 - Port Louis - Port working normally. Two container vessels alongside for discharging and loading. 1 General cargo discharging. No idle vessels in port, 1 in drydock.
PHILIPPINES, October 28 - Manila - South harbour - 12 Vessels discharging at berth, 5 discharging at anchorage, no berthing delays.

SIERRA LEONE, October 28 - Freetown - Vessels due, 1 general cargo loader, 2 container dischargers, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 oil tanker discharger, no delays expected. Vessels discharging/loading at berth, 1 rice, 1 general cargo, 1 container vessel. Vessels anchored, 1 rice, 1 other vessel. Vessels must be in/out of port before 1900 hours.

SOUTH KOREA, October 29, - Inchon - Seventy-three vessels in port (48 berthed, 25 anchored) of which 7 logs, 6 general cargo, 5 steel, 4 container vessels, 3 each wheat blending pellets, steel plates, scrap, 2 each raw sugar, plywood, wheat, cars, 1 each cement, ingots, glass, rape seed meal, pig iron, fertiliser, tapioca, coils, corn. Anchored, 5 general cargo, 3 logs, 2 each containers, plywood, cars, coils, 1 each wheat blending pellets, wheat, talc, tapioca, scrap, meal, hydroxide, pig iron, steel. Busan - 162 Vessels in port (49 berthed. 113 anchored including 56 laid up) of which 34 general cargo, 7 container vessels, 4 each scrap, coal. 57 awaiting berth, 2 days delay expected.

Pohang - 24 In port (20 berthed, 4 anchored) of which discharging, 4 steel billets, 2 each coils, scrap, 1 each iron ore, coke, structural, wire rods, benzene. 7 Vessels loading steel. 4 Vessels awaiting berth with approx. 1-2 days delay. Ulsan - 33 in port (28 berthed, 5 anchored) of which discharging, 2 each coal, caustic soda, steel pipes, woodchips, crude oil, 1 each feed, logs, ortho xylene, fertiliser, raw sugar, zinc concentrates, copper concentrates, mono ethyl glycol, corn. Loading, 4 general cargo, 1 each fertiliser, naphtha, chemicals. 5 Feed vessels awaiting berth with approx. 5 days delay expected. Masan - Four vessels berthed of which discharging, 1 each steel scrap, tapioca. Loading, 1 cigars, 1 steel structural, no berthing delays expected.

SRI LANKA, October 29 - Colombo - Six vessels due, 1-2 days delay expected. 11 Vessels loading at berth of which 2 essential cargo, 9 container vessels. 30 Vessels discharging at berth of which 1 essential service cargo, 2 bagged sugar, 1 bagged rice and maize, 1 lpg, 4 general cargo (country craft), 1 bagged fertiliser, 1 bagged cement and steel, 2 bagged flour, 15 container vessels, 1 bagged rice and steel, 1 steel. 9 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge of which 6 containers discharging/loading, 3 rice. 1 Vessel for bunkers, 4 under repair/drydock, 5 awaiting orders. Galle - One vessel discharging at berth. Trincomalee - Two vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth.

TAIWAN, October 24 - Keelung - Four vessels anchored. Berthing delays, coal 2 days, steel 1 day, iron ore 3 days, no delays for grain. Kaohsiung - Two vessels anchored. Berthing delays, grain 1 day, iron/coal 4 days (CSC berth), coal/scrap (public berth) 1 day, steel 1 day. Taichung - Seven anchored. Delays, grain 3-4 days, iron ore, coal, steel and others 1-2 days, no delays for scrap. October 28 - Kaohsiung - Vessels in port, 11 containers, 5 tankers, 3 grain, 3 other bulkers, 38 generals, 10 buoys. No delays. Keelung - Vessels in port, 11 containers, 1 tanker, 8 other bulkers, 3 general. 4 Containers waiting at outer anchorage with 8 hours berthing delay expected.
